title_chain.zh_h1: 布鲁诺·鲍威尔 Bauer, Bruno (Douglas Moggach and Gabriele Schimmenti)

spot.html_text: In his studies of the French Revolution and its impact on Germany, Bauer traced the emergence of mass society, based on conformity and inchoate particularism. The dissolution of the feudal estates by the Revolution produced a purely atomistic society, characterized by the assertion of individual property right.
